title.en: Chapter 18 — What the Trainer Was Doing
title.ar: الفصل 18 — شو كان بده يعمل المدرب

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: بعد أربع أيام، كنا بالسباق، مع الكولونيل، وهو زعلان ومش مصدق.
sentences.en: Four days later, we were at the race, with the colonel, angry and unbelieving.
He said: my horse is not here.

sentences.ar: وإنت جبتني عالسباق عشان أتفرج على خسارتي؟
sentences.en: And you brought me to the race to watch my defeat?
Holmes said: your horse is number four.

sentences.ar: وطلعت الخيل، وخرج حصان بني، بلا أي علامة بيضا، والكولونيل قال: هاد مش حصاني!
sentences.en: And the horses came out, and a brown horse appeared, with no white mark, and the colonel said: that is not my horse!
My horse has a white blaze!
Holmes said: wait.

sentences.ar: وركض الحصان البني، وربح السباق بطول جسمين، وما حدا قرب منه.
sentences.en: And the brown horse ran, and won the race by two lengths, with no one near it.

sentences.ar: وبعدين أخد هولمز الكولونيل للحصان، وغسل جبينه وإجريه بمي وروح.
sentences.en: And then Holmes took the colonel to the horse, and washed its forehead and legs with spirit.
And the brown came off, and the white appeared.
Silver Blaze.
The colonel said: where was he?
Holmes said: at Brown's.

sentences.ar: الأثر بالطين وصل لعنده، وبراون لقاه بالمرج بالصبح، وعرفه.
sentences.en: The track in the mud led there, and Brown found him on the moor in the morning, and knew him.

sentences.ar: وحسب إنه إذا خباه لبعد السباق، حصانه بيربح.
sentences.en: And reckoned that if he hid him until after the race, his own horse would win.
So he dyed him.

sentences.ar: وأنا حكيت له إني عارف، وخيرته: يرجعه ويسكت، أو الشرطة.
sentences.en: And I told him I knew, and gave him a choice: return him and keep quiet, or the police.
The colonel said: and who killed the trainer?
Holmes said: the horse.
And the colonel looked at him as if he were mad.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: المدرب كان عنده ست تانية بلندن.
sentences.en: Holmes said: the trainer had another woman in London.
She loved dresses, and dresses are expensive.

sentences.ar: فراهن ضد حصانه، بمصاري كبيرة، وقرر يخليه يخسر.
sentences.en: So he bet against his own horse, heavily, and decided to make it lose.
Not with poison, because it shows.

sentences.ar: بجرح زغير بالعضلة، بسكين جراح، ما حدا بيشوفه، وبيخلي الحصان يعرج.
sentences.en: With a small cut in the tendon, with a surgeon's knife, that no one sees, and that makes the horse go lame.

sentences.ar: وخدر الصبي بالكاري، لأنه الكاري بيغطي طعم الأفيون.
sentences.en: And he drugged the lad with the curry, because curry hides the taste of opium.
And he was the one who ordered curry.

sentences.ar: وطلع بالليل بالحصان للمرج، بعيد عن الإسطبل، عشان ما حدا يسمع.
sentences.en: And he took the horse out at night onto the moor, far from the stable, so no one would hear.

sentences.ar: وشعل شمعة، لأنه الشغل بده تركيز.
sentences.en: And lit a candle, because the work needed concentration.
And we found the candle with him.

sentences.ar: وربطة عنق سيمبسون، لقاها بالطريق، وأخدها عشان يربط فيها إجر الحصان.
sentences.en: And Simpson's cravat, he had found on the path, and took it to tie the horse's leg.

sentences.ar: وركع ورا الحصان، وشعل الشمعة، والحصان خاف من الضو، ورفس.
sentences.en: And he knelt behind the horse, lit the candle, and the horse took fright at the light, and kicked.

sentences.ar: وحدوته ضربت راسه، وهو واقع، جرح فخده بسكينه.
sentences.en: And its shoe struck his head, and as he fell, he cut his thigh with his own knife.

sentences.ar: وهرب الحصان بالمرج، لحد ما لقاه براون.
sentences.en: And the horse fled across the moor, until Brown found him.

sentences.ar: قال الكولونيل: وكيف عرفت إنه المدرب؟
sentences.en: The colonel said: and how did you know it was the trainer?
Holmes said: the dog.
And the curry.
And the knife that was not for defending.
And the dressmaker's bill.

sentences.ar: رحت لخياطة السيدات بلندن مبارح بصورة المدرب، وقالت: أي، هاد السيد دربيشير.
sentences.en: I went to the dressmaker in London yesterday with the trainer's photograph, and she said: yes, this is Mr. Derbyshire.

sentences.ar: وبقيت شغلة وحدة ما كنت متأكد منها، وسألت راعي غنم بالمرج.
sentences.en: And one thing remained I was not sure of, and I asked a shepherd on the moor.

sentences.ar: سألته: بأيام قبل الحادثة، عرج شي من غنمك؟
sentences.en: I asked him: in the days before, did any of your sheep go lame?
He said: three.
The trainer had been practising on the sheep.

sentences.ar: والكولونيل سكت، وبعدين مد إيده، وقال: سامحني على اللي قلته.
sentences.en: And the colonel was silent, and then held out his hand, and said: forgive me for what I said.
And Holmes said: no need.
The horse won.
And that is what matters.
